newsitem.title: SPAIN: Sevillana sees electric output up strongly.
newsitem.headline: Sevillana sees electric output up strongly.

text.p: Spain's Sevillana de Electricidad said on Wednesday it had completed the first part of a process to convert its Bahia de Algeciras plant to use natural gas, predicting this would strongly increase output.
The gas used to power the plant is from the Algeria-Europe gas pipeline, inaugurated earlier this week.
This section of the plant has installed capacity of 220 megawatts and Sevillana has invested around 4 billion pesetas in this phase of the project.
The second section will require investment of a further 5.58 billion pesetas, and will bring on stream 533 megawatts more power once it is modernised, Sevillana said.
